properties.title: AIO Fact Check
properties.content: Question: does covid effect ears Answer: Yes, COVID-19 can affect the ears. The virus can cause ear infections, such as otitis media (middle ear infection) and otitis externa (swimmer's ear). It can also lead to: ear pain, hearing loss, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), dizziness, and vertigo. In some cases, these ear problems may be the only symptom of COVID-19. If you experience any ear symptoms, it is important to get tested for COVID-19, especially if you have other symptoms of the virus, such as fever, cough, or shortness of breath.

Question: does covid effect ears

Answer: Yes, COVID-19 can affect the ears. The virus can cause ear infections, such as otitis media (middle ear infection) and otitis externa (swimmer's ear). It can also lead to:
ear pain, hearing loss, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), dizziness, and vertigo.
In some cases, these ear problems may be the only symptom of COVID-19. If you experience any ear symptoms, it is important to get tested for COVID-19, especially if you have other symptoms of the virus, such as fever, cough, or shortness of breath.
